title: CIA Office of Research and Development continues MK Ultra work

tellings.quote: According to John Marx in the search for the manurion candidate, that division was the office of research and development or OARD led by Steven Aldrich.

plain: The CIA's secret mind and drug experiments, known as MK Ultra, were carried on by a CIA division called the Office of Research and Development, led by a man named Stephen Aldrich. Michels takes this from the book The Search for the Manchurian Candidate by John Marks. He tells it as the link to later work, including the start of the US remote viewing programme, the effort to train people to see distant places with the mind.
